major_stories.headline: Bucket strategy deployed in retirement needs a refill rule
major_stories.brief_details: While the bucket strategy for retirement is popular, it often lacks a clear rule on how and when to refill the safe bucket. Experts suggest hybrid funds or disciplined rebalancing as better automated alternatives.
bullet_points: Separate bucket strategy risks leaving cash buckets empty if not refilled systematically.
Human emotion often leads to market timing errors when manually refilling buckets.
Hybrid funds automatically rebalance and move money from debt to equity after a fall.
Sequence-of-returns risk can permanently damage portfolios if drawdowns occur early in retirement.
